project.title: E01 - Phân đoạn 01 - Ranh giới mưa và cát
project.logline: Ami flees a decaying city into Obrion's desert, cannot bring herself to kill a pursuer, and discovers that the land is deadlier than either side of the chase.
project.country_setting: Fictional planet Obrion: acid-rain city gate and dead red desert
project.pacing_profile: 300 seconds. Oppressive long static holds; handheld only when Ami or the bike physically loses control. No heroic score.

beat_sheet.setup: Ami flees the corroded city, visibly frightened.
beat_sheet.tension_rising: Squid vehicles follow her across the border into empty desert.
beat_sheet.confrontation: She raises her bow but deliberately hesitates; the arrow misses.
beat_sheet.reveal: The desert itself moves and swallows the lead vehicle.
beat_sheet.aftermath: Ami reaches toward a surviving enemy but cannot save him; a vast shadow covers her.
